Palestine Technical College

📍 Deir al-Balah, Deir al-Balah
Technical College Deir al-Balah Operational

Palestine Technical College in Deir al-Balah is the primary technical and vocational higher education institution in the central Gaza Strip. It offers two-year technical diploma programmes in engineering technology, computer science, and applied sciences, providing practical workforce training for Gaza's economy.
